messages:
sam: Customer (acme) reports SSO failures starting ~08:10 UTC after IdP cert rotation. Users see login loop and our backend logs show 'Signature verification failed' + ACS endpoint mismatch.

sam: Quick facts: metadata URL https://idp.acme.com/metadata returns XML but Content-Type is 'text/xml; charset=ISO-8859-1' and the file appears to be missing an explicit XML declaration (no <?xml ...?>).

sam: Commands run:
```
curl -sI https://idp.acme.com/metadata | grep -i Content-Type
Content-Type: text/xml; charset=ISO-8859-1

curl -s https://idp.acme.com/metadata | sed -n '1,6p'
<md:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme.com/">
  <md:Signature ...>...
```

sam: Redwood log snippet: 
``
SAMLValidationError: Signature verification failed (digest mismatch). computed=acb123... expected=def456...
AssertionConsumerService check: expected https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs but got https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs?env=prod
``

sam: Need guidance: can we hotfix on our side (metadata cache refresh / re-encoding / relaxed matching) or must IdP republish? Customer is blocked.

morgan: Please paste the full metadata URL (confirmed) and the new signer fingerprint if you have it. Also is there a BOM or weird first byte? If the IdP served ISO-8859-1 bytes but signature was computed on a canonicalized UTF-8 stream the digest will differ.

alice: Short-term remediation options: 1) Ask IdP to republish metadata with explicit UTF-8 encoding and include XML declaration `<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>`. 2) If they can't do that immediately we can proxy/convert their metadata on our side: `iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8 metadata.xml > metadata.utf8.xml` then reload.

morgan: I'm going to try a metadata refresh for acme-idp from our side: `redwoodctl metadata refresh --entity acme-idp` — will report back. Also evaluating a transient flag to allow relaxed ACS matching for query params for this tenant.

jamie: I've opened ticket SUP-123456 and put all logs + reproduction steps there. Escalating to eng-identity and account team. @morgan @alice please add any CLI outputs you run.

idp-monitor-bot: Detected metadata change for entity acme-idp at 2026-03-17T08:14:22Z. New signer fingerprint=12:34:56:78:9A:BC

morgan: Forced refresh completed, but validation still fails. Root cause looks like encoding/canonicalization mismatch: signature was generated over bytes interpreted as ISO-8859-1 by IdP but our canonicalization pipeline expects UTF-8. I'm rolling a targeted patch to re-encode metadata server-side for acme-idp and relax signature byte-matching to allow canonicalization normalization for 10 minutes while we coordinate.

sam: Customer republished metadata with explicit UTF-8 header at 08:34 UTC and we've cleared our cache. I verified SSO login succeeded for multiple users.

jamie: Thanks team — leaving SUP-123456 open for 24h monitoring, then we'll close.

sam: Closing thread here; will update ticket with final timeline and root cause (IdP served metadata without XML declaration + ISO-8859-1 charset causing signature digest mismatch after cert rotation).
